svg.text: Distinct A5 / B5 rails • Retain four USB roles • Basis 0b431a9
Matching remote labels and rails join electrically. X is deliberate NC. See REVIEW.md for fit and power holds.
Insulate former VBUS lands. They carry SYS5.
X marks an unused pin or isolated pad.
Built-in GP16 pixel has no external link.
3.3 V SPI microSD breakout, exact fit open
Numbers identify card functions. Confirm actual breakout pad order.
Use an SD assembly with 3.3 V logic, card pulls and local bypass.
Fit J5/J6 only after combined rail qualification. J6 needs onboard 3.3 V I2C pulls. Verify connector polarity.
J7 and J8 are 3.3 V data and common ground only. Connect or remove local accessories with power off.
